name: net.youmi.overseas.offers.background.receiver.PackageReceiver
description: When Android reports an app install or removal, the Youmi Overseas Offers Wall SDK updates its installed-app tracking and checks whether a pending task should open that app. The receiver is also registered for boot, package-replacement, and keyboard-change notices.
disableEffect: App-install offers will no longer update their tracking or resume a waiting task app, while the host app’s other features remain available.
